subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: Should OpenClaw expose same-turn transcript, tool-call, and result evidence to outbound pre-send plugin hooks, and what bounded permissioned SDK shape should own it?
rationale: The remaining work would define a public plugin-visible evidence boundary with sensitive session data, so automation should not choose the API shape, redaction model, or permission semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add bounded evidence contract
options.body: Expose outbound run identity plus a redacted, size-limited evidence object through the plugin SDK and document which plugins may consume it.

options.title: Ship identity-only correlation first
options.body: Thread outbound runId into message hooks now and keep transcript/tool-result evidence tracked as a separate product/security design item.

options.title: Treat existing hooks as sufficient
options.body: Close this request in favor of `reply_payload_sending` plus `message_sending`, accepting that deterministic claim verification remains plugin-managed.

recommendation.title: Add bounded evidence contract
recommendation.body: Expose outbound run identity plus a redacted, size-limited evidence object through the plugin SDK and document which plugins may consume it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent hook-contract documentation work and product/security boundary context make this the best available owner for the API-shape decision.
